title: Vaidehi Kathirunthal
desc: Vaidehi, a widow and Vellaisamy, a homeless man, undergo a drastic turn in their lives as they join forces to save a young couple from the fury of the villagers.

title: Chirai Chaalai
desc: A doctor is falsely accused of bombing a train and sent to a prison called Kaalapani in Port Blair. After living in the prison, he observes that the inmates there are treated inhumanely.

title: Sigappu Rojakkal
desc: A young man, traumatised by his past, grows up to despise the opposite sex and exploits them. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with a woman prisoner while in jail.

title: Sollamale
desc: Shwetha, a rich and kind woman, assumes that Nadaraj cannot speak and shows empathy towards him. When their friendship blossoms into love, Nadaraj faces an arduous task of confessing the truth.

title: Pithamagan
desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.
